title: I gave ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok $100,000 each to beat the market. Here’s week one.
author: alphagroundhq
selftext:
Ask an AI how to beat the stock market, and it will give you a brilliant-sounding essay. What it won’t tell you is whether the idea actually makes money, or whether it blows up the first time the market flinches.

Talking is cheap. Trading is the test. So I put them on the clock.

I gave ChatGPT Astra, Claude Fable 5.1, Gemini Argon and Grok 4.7, each on its best model, the exact same prompt: **build a purely rule-based strategy to beat the S&P 500 between now and December 31, with $100,000. US stocks and ETFs only. No judgment calls.**

Then I plugged their answers into trading agents playground and turned each one into a live trading agent. Once the bell rang on Tuesday, October 20, the AIs couldn’t change their minds. Their rules took the wheel, trading at real market prices every day.

The screenshot shows what each AI came up with.  
Check out the blog post for the full results.
